method: Visual review of all 114 pages rendered with pymupdf at 200 dpi, outside the repo; no OCR. Positions use 1-based pages and printed row/column labels.
policy: Merge individual measurements only when the document also prints an agreeing delay average or repeated summary. Count checks are recorded but do not verify values. Candidates in unread are never merged.
